mcqs.learning_point: Represent solutions on a number line
mcqs.question:
The inequality 3x - 5 > 4 is to be represented on a number line. Which of the following sketches is correct?
A) A closed circle at 3 with shading to the right.
B) An open circle at 3 with shading to the right.
C) A closed circle at 3 with shading to the left.
D) An open circle at 3 with shading to the left.

options.A: A closed circle at 3 with shading to the right.
options.B: An open circle at 3 with shading to the right.
options.C: A closed circle at 3 with shading to the left.
options.D: An open circle at 3 with shading to the left.

mcqs.answer: An open circle at 3 with shading to the right.
mcqs.explanation: First solve the inequality: 3x - 5 > 4 ⇒ 3x > 9 ⇒ x > 3. The solution consists of all numbers greater than 3, not including 3 itself. On a number line this is shown by an open (unfilled) circle at 3 and shading to the right. A closed circle would incorrectly indicate that 3 is part of the solution.

mcqs.question: Solve the inequality 2 - x ≤ 5 and write the solution set in interval notation.
mcqs.explanation: 2 - x ≤ 5 ⇒ -x ≤ 3 ⇒ x ≥ -3. All real numbers greater than or equal to -3 satisfy the inequality. In interval notation this is written as [-3, ∞), where the square bracket indicates that -3 is included.

mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly describes the solution set of the compound inequality -2 < 3x - 1 ≤ 7?
mcqs.explanation: Add 1 to all parts: -1 < 3x ≤ 8. Divide by 3 (positive, so inequality signs stay the same): -1/3 < x ≤ 8/3. The left endpoint is not included (open), the right endpoint is included (closed), giving the interval (-1/3, 8/3]. Options B, C, and D either reverse the inclusion symbols or describe a different set.

mcqs.question: The inequality 4 - 2x > 0 has its solution set represented as:
mcqs.explanation: Solve: 4 - 2x > 0 ⇒ -2x > -4 ⇒ x < 2 (dividing by -2 reverses the sign). Hence every real number smaller than 2 satisfies the inequality. Option A is the opposite, C restricts the range unnecessarily, and D is false because solutions exist.

mcqs.question: Solve the inequality 5x - 3 ≤ 2x + 7.
mcqs.explanation: Subtract 2x from both sides: 3x - 3 ≤ 7. Add 3: 3x ≤ 10. Divide by 3: x ≤ 10/3. The inequality includes the endpoint, so the correct choice is A. Options B, C, and D either reverse the inequality or change the inclusion of the endpoint.

mcqs.learning_point: Represent solutions on a number line
mcqs.question: Which description correctly represents the solution set of the inequality x ≤ -1 on a number line?

options.A: A closed circle at -1 with shading to the left.
options.B: An open circle at -1 with shading to the left.
options.C: A closed circle at -1 with shading to the right.
options.D: An open circle at -1 with shading to the right.

mcqs.answer: A closed circle at -1 with shading to the left.
mcqs.explanation: x ≤ -1 includes -1 itself, so the point -1 is marked with a closed (filled) circle. Since the inequality is "less than or equal to", the shading extends to the left (toward smaller numbers). Options B, C, and D either use an open circle or shade in the wrong direction.

mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly expresses the solution set of x > 4 using interval notation?
mcqs.explanation: x > 4 includes all numbers greater than 4 but not 4 itself. In interval notation this is written as (4, ∞), where the parenthesis indicates that 4 is excluded. Option B incorrectly includes 4, while C and D describe the opposite set.

mcqs.question: The temperature T (in °C) satisfies -5 ≤ T - 3 < 7. What is the range of possible values of T?
mcqs.explanation: Add 3 to each part of the compound inequality: -5 + 3 ≤ T < 7 + 3 ⇒ -2 ≤ T < 10. The left endpoint is included (≤) and the right endpoint is excluded (<), giving the interval [-2, 10). Option C matches this. The other options either exclude the left endpoint or include the right endpoint incorrectly.
